## What to do

`scripts/ci/nightly-tiers-card.mjs`, `scheduled-full-run-card.mjs` and `scheduled-full-run.mjs` open cards with the `bug` label and no native issue type. Give them the native type (and area:fleet, and no `domain:*`), so the old type labels can retire.

## Done when
